meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 处理 HyperFrames 动画时，会先明确动画主体和起止状态，再选用最简单恰当的动画手法编写关键帧，最后用命令行工具检查与修正，使成品能在时间轴上拖动且画面正确。
howto.when: 当你的 HyperFrames 项目需要添加或修复动画关键帧（如 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、SVG 变形等），或要求运行 `hyperframes keyframes` 诊断时。

say.text: 给这个元素加一段沿路径移动的关键帧动画
say.note: Claude 会创建可拖动的路径关键帧并验证。

say.text: 用 GSAP 时间线让盒子先放大再旋转
say.note: Claude 会构建并注册暂停的时间线。

say.text: 诊断当前合成的关键帧有没有问题
say.note: Claude 会运行检查并修复错误。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will identify the animated subject, visible states, and runtime, choose the smallest mechanism, author seek-safe keyframes, and verify them with CLI tools, producing correct frames that can be scrubbed on a timeline.
howto.when_en: When your HyperFrames project needs to add or fix animation keyframes (such as GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, SVG morphing, etc.), or when you ask to run the `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics.

say_en.text: Add a keyframe animation that moves this element along a path.
say_en.note: Claude creates seek-safe path keyframes and verifies them.

say_en.text: Use a GSAP timeline to scale then rotate this box.
say_en.note: Claude builds and registers a paused timeline.

say_en.text: Diagnose the keyframes in the current composition.
say_en.note: Claude runs keyframe checks and fixes any issues.
